problem_text:
A logistics manager must select cargo containers for shipment. Available containers are:
* Container A: weight 38 tons, revenue $121K
* Container B: weight 33 tons, revenue $81K
* Container C: weight 19 tons, revenue $81K
* Container D: weight 49 tons, revenue $58K
* Container E: weight 40 tons, revenue $138K
The transport vessel has a maximum capacity of 125 tons. Choose the container combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each container must be shipped entirely or not at all.
